metadata.title: Basic Arithmetic Recall Quiz – Smoke Test
metadata.instructions: Select the most appropriate answer for each question. Each question carries 1 mark.

questions.question_text: According to the SEE Course Plan, what percentage of the total assessment marks is allocated to CO1?
questions.answer_key: 40% – CO1 accounts for 40% of the total marks.
questions.notes: Source: CSE Scheme and Syllabus 7th_8th_1.pdf, page 39 (CO1 weightage 40%).

assessment.generation_notes: Questions derived exclusively from the provided syllabus excerpts (Source 2, page 39). Bloom level: Remember. Difficulty: Easy. All items map to CO1.

strengths: Both questions include an answer key, facilitating automated grading.
Each question is explicitly mapped to CO1, ensuring clear alignment with the stated outcome.
weaknesses: Only the Remember level is represented; no higher-order Bloom levels are assessed.
Both items target the same course outcome (CO1), leaving other COs uncovered.
The assessment contains only Easy difficulty questions, providing no challenge gradient.
Total marks (2) and question count (2) are insufficient for a meaningful quiz in most higher‑education contexts.
suggestions: Introduce at least one Apply‑level or higher question that requires students to use CO1 knowledge in a new context.
Add items mapped to other course outcomes (e.g., CO2, CO3) to achieve broader OBE coverage.
Incorporate Medium and Hard difficulty questions to create a balanced cognitive load.
Consider adding a Create‑level scenario or project‑based item if the assessment type permits.
reviewer_result.reviewer_notes: The quiz functions as a very basic smoke test but requires substantial enrichment to meet OBE standards for a university‑level assessment.
